Privacy Policy

Last updated and effective as of 13 November 2026.

Nothing about you is collected, except the specific things listed in this policy. No tracking, no profiling, no selling.

The short version: nothing about you is collected beyond what is explicitly written here. What follows is the complete list, in plain words.

1. Definitions

  • “This site”, “the site” — the website at https://saif-it.pages.dev, including every page and file served from it.
  • “I”, “me”, “the owner” — Saif Bin Shahab, who runs this site.
  • “You”, “visitor” — anyone who visits the site or submits a form on it.
  • “Personal information” — information that identifies you or can be linked to you, such as a name, an email address, or a phone number.
  • “Forms” — the contact form and the review forms.
  • “Review forms” — the feedback forms for written works published on this site.
  • “Host” — Cloudflare Pages, the service that delivers this site to your browser.

2. What this site does not do

  • No analytics and no visitor statistics that identify you.
  • No advertising, tracking pixels, or behavioural profiling.
  • No cookies set by this site for tracking.
  • No personal information is sold.
  • No database of visitors. The only information that exists is what you deliberately submit through a form, and it is handled as described below.

3. What is processed to deliver a page

This site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Like any web host, Cloudflare processes standard technical request data in order to serve pages and keep the site online: your IP address, the page or file requested, the date and time, your browser and device type (user-agent), the page you came from, and an approximate location.

Cloudflare uses this for normal operation and security — caching, bot protection, and defence against attacks. It is processed on Cloudflare's systems, under Cloudflare's Privacy Policy. I do not receive it as a readable record and I do not keep copies of it.

4. Cookies and local storage

This site does not use cookies of its own. The only thing it stores on your device is your light/dark theme preference, kept in your browser's local storage. That value stays in your browser and is never sent to me.

Cloudflare may set its own security cookies (for example, to verify that a visitor is not a bot). Those cookies belong to Cloudflare and are governed by their policy above. Clearing site data in your browser removes the local theme setting.

5. Third-party services

A few outside services are involved in showing this site. None of them are used for advertising or tracking, but each one receives your IP address as part of any normal web request:

  • Cloudflare Pages — hosting, caching, and security.
  • Google Fonts — delivers the typefaces used on the site (Google Privacy Policy).
  • Web3Forms — only if you choose to submit one of the forms (Web3Forms Privacy Policy).

6. The forms, and what they send

Forms are the only way this site receives anything from you, and using them is entirely voluntary. Both types are delivered through Web3Forms to my inbox, but they are treated differently.

(a) Contact form — private

The contact form asks for your name, an email address or phone number, and your message. It is used only to read your message and reply to you. What you send through it is not published, not shared, and not added to a mailing list. Please do not send passwords, financial details, identity documents, or anything else sensitive. Emailing me directly works the same way.

(b) Review forms — may be published

Review forms ask for your name (required), a star rating, what helped you, and any suggestions, plus an optional permission checkbox. A submitted review is not private. By submitting a review form, you agree that the content you submit may be used and shared for testimonial and marketing purposes — on this site or elsewhere, together with your name. Do not include anything you would not want published. If you do not agree to that, please email me instead: hello@saif.example.com.

7. What you control

  • You can use the entire site without submitting anything.
  • You can block third-party requests (such as fonts) in your browser.
  • You can clear cookies and local storage at any time.
  • You can ask me to delete a contact message you have sent at any time by emailing hello@saif.example.com.
  • You can ask me to take down a published review. Once a review has been shared, copies made elsewhere may stay outside my control.

8. Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the date at the top of this page changes with it. There is no hidden collection now, and any future change will be written here, not discovered later.

9. Contact

Questions about privacy on this site: hello@saif.example.com.
